reasoning: On the season so far the Magic are the stronger team; with home court the Magic start about 1 points better, in a game of about 225 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Magic.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Jazz (look-ahead).
Bottom line: the Magic win 55 times in 100; most games like this end between 195 and 243 total points.
